# gigahost_server_catalog (Data Source)

Returns the full deploy catalog: every product tier, product, and region, including raw `product_id`/`price_id`. Prefer `gigahost_server_size` for selecting a single size by slug; use this to enumerate the whole catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The full deploy catalog: every tier, product, and region.
data "gigahost_server_catalog" "all" {}

output "product_names" {
  value = flatten([for t in data.gigahost_server_catalog.all.tiers : [for p in t.products : p.name]])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) ISO currency code prices are quoted in.
- `regions` (Attributes List) Every deploy region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Catalog tiers, each grouping comparable products. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) True when the region accepts new deployments.
- `country` (String) Two-letter country code.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `name` (String) Product name as shown in the control panel.
- `name_short` (String) Short code, e.g. `SFJ, NO`.


<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Read-Only:

- `group_id` (String) Internal ID of the catalog tier.
- `group_name` (String) Catalog tier name, e.g. `KVM Value`.
- `products` (Attributes List) Products within the tier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--products))

<a id="nestedatt--tiers--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers.products`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth_gb` (Number) Included bandwidth in GB.
- `category` (String) Catalog category the size belongs to.
- `cores` (Number) Virtual CPU cores.
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory in GB.
- `name` (String) Product name as shown in the control panel.
- `platform` (String) Platform: `cloud` or `metal`.
- `price_id` (String) Raw catalog price ID, required to deploy.
- `product_id` (String) Raw catalog product ID, required to deploy.
- `rate_hourly` (Number) Hourly price in the account's currency.
- `rate_monthly` (Number) Monthly price in the account's currency.
- `region_ids` (List of String) IDs of the regions this can be deployed to.
- `slug` (String) Stable slug used to select this by name.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Disk in GB, summed across all disks.
